Standard: Escape systems recover crewmembers from zero altitude AGL (in level flight) up to the absolute ceiling of the air vehicle and from zero airspeed up to the maximum velocity of the air vehicle or 600 KEAS whichever is less. Escape systems meet user escape system terrain clearance requirements. Capability above 600 KEAS may be required for escape systems that enclose the crewmembers (e.g., an escape capsule). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Analysis of the ejection sled test data is used to validate a DoW approved trajectory model.
(2) The validated dynamic trajectory model shows that the escape system recovers crewmembers across the escape envelope. Test.
  (1) Lab test: System-level dynamic ejection sled testing demonstrates trajectories in all three dimensions, across the speed range and occupant weights for all air vehicle seat positions. This data is used to validate dynamic trajectory models used to predict terrain clearance.
